title.narrative: o The responsible institution to ensure that the number of times a child can be questioned is limited to maximum two, and video recording is made admissible as evidence in criminal and civil courts, and a substitute for the public hearing of the child (RKLA 2)(43124)

actual.value: 2020:The number of times a child can be questioned is limited at 2, as specified in the Juvenile Justice Code. The video recordings made admissible are not yet fully applicable in any of the proceedings including in police, prosecutors and courts.

actual.value: 2020:The procedures and services for children in contact with the law are in place and applied as contained in the revised Juvenile Justice Code and other penal and child protection related legislation
